title: B Step 1: three published prescriptions at quadratic spectator order
branch_policy: Reuse codex/grut-closure-fork-20261019 as the single B Step 1 branch; open no additional branch and execute no B Step 2 or 3.

model.metric: ds^2=-N^2 dt^2/q + q dOmega_3^2; t in [0,1]
model.mode_action: one half integral[q^2 zdot^2/N - N ell(ell+2) z^2]dt
model.mode_definition: real, massless, minimally coupled spectator with integral Y^2 dOmega_3 = 1; not an inflaton curvature perturbation
model.approximation: quadratic mode action on background saddles; leading semiclassical lapse saddle expansion; no mode backreaction or fluctuation prefactor correction to the width
model.width_convention: Psi proportional exp[-(B+i C) z1^2/(2 hbar)]; B = Im[q1^2 zdot(1)/(N z(1))]. Negative B is an inverse-Gaussian coefficient, not a variance.

prescriptions.a: Dirichlet q0=0, positive-real lapse with convergent endpoint deformation; FLT 1703.02076,1705.00192
prescriptions.b: Dirichlet q0=0, whole-real lapse contour passing below zero; 1705.05340; report the Gaussian envelope of each WKB component, not a single exact Gaussian for the saddle sum
prescriptions.c: Di Tucci-Lehners Robin alpha=-6 pi^2 i, beta=-i b/(3 pi^2), b=1.5, contour emanating from Nstar=3 pi^2 beta toward positive infinity in the corresponding relative cycle

source_expectations_before_execution.a: upper-right Dirichlet saddle; B<0, late-size coefficient B -> -ell(ell+1)(ell+2)/H^2
source_expectations_before_execution.b: two lower Dirichlet saddles; positive B envelope, B -> +ell(ell+1)(ell+2)/H^2
source_expectations_before_execution.c: one lower-right original-lapse saddle at admissible b; positive B with the same late-size coefficient
source_expectations_before_execution.normalization_warning: 1903.06757 displays a pi^2 action and an asymptotic unit-mode coefficient without that factor. Audit the PDF explicitly; do not hide a possible 2 pi^2 convention mismatch by fitting a width.

numerical_plan.background: Find all roots of the reduced-action derivative, derive Robin reduction by independent elimination of q0, and calculate oriented upward-flow intersections with representative prescribed contours.
numerical_plan.flow_controls: Use small phase tilts to resolve Stokes connections, check both tilt signs if feasible, and refine arclength/cutoff. Record unresolved or regulator-dependent intersections rather than supplying desired saddle lists.
numerical_plan.modes: Integrate the common complex mode ODE with the regular Frobenius branch z~t^(ell/2), without prescribing Im K or the final width. Compare with an independently differentiated closed mode solution and the published large-q coefficients.
numerical_plan.large_q_acceptance: At q1=10000, ell=2, compare the finite-size result to the published asymptotic value with its explicit O(1/q1) correction; do not demand equality at finite size.
numerical_plan.contour_acceptance: Expected contributing saddle sets must be recovered from oriented flow intersections or an independently evaluated contour, with cutoff/regulator sensitivity reported. If only prescribed saddle widths are obtained, label Step 1 partial.

decision_rules.control_pass: All three prescription-specific saddle selections and canonical widths reproduced in stated leading approximation. This is established physics, not a GRUT prediction or a solution of the full contour dispute.
decision_rules.partial: Widths agree but a contour or normalization issue remains unresolved; do not label the three-prescription control complete.
decision_rules.failure: A disagreement survives refinement or the stated prescriptions cannot be implemented consistently; report the offending datum and do not advance the selection claim.
decision_rules.hypothesis_status: Failure of one closure definition does not disprove every possible observer/state principle. No success criterion promises a universal theory.

resource_limits: Existing Python, NumPy and SciPy only; bounded local runs, no package installation, paid resources, external messages, or indefinite jobs.
